title: The Control Layer Behind Rule-Following Agents Trading Across Market Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2610.26324v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Trading discipline often fails people. Our study tested whether four AI trading agents followed their strategies and risk rules. Offering traders the evidence and an agent evaluation toolkit to separate luck from following the rules, before giving agents meaningful autonomy or capital. Our study analysed 2,627 closed positions from 12 February to 27 August 2026 across the same asset universe and execution conditions. Most positions were simulated against live prices with a 0.09% round-trip fee; 18% involved real Hyperliquid orders. Each position declared a strategy, stop and target, with a limit of five open positions per agent. The fleet finished net positive after fees. Rule adherence was high across all four agents, including the unprofitable one. Profitability tracked how often agents won relative to their break-even win rates. translated_title: 跨市场环境下规则遵循型交易智能体背后的控制层
translated_abstract: 交易纪律常常让人失败。我们的研究测试了四个AI交易智能体是否遵循了它们的策略和风险规则。在给予智能体有意义的自主权或资金之前，为交易者提供证据和一个智能体评估工具包，以区分运气与规则遵循。我们的研究分析了2026年2月12日至8月27日期间的2,627个已平仓头寸，涵盖相同的资产范围和执行条件。大多数头寸是针对实时价格进行模拟的，往返费用为0.09%；其中18%涉及真实的Hyperliquid订单。每个头寸都声明了策略、止损和目标，每个智能体最多持有五个未平仓头寸。整个智能体群在扣除费用后最终实现净盈利。所有四个智能体的规则遵循度都很高，包括亏损的那个。盈利能力取决于智能体的胜率相对于其盈亏平衡胜率的表现。机构级风格的风控默认运行，并在29%的市场回撤中控制了损失。
tldr: 该研究通过分析四个AI交易智能体在七个月内产生的2,627个平仓头寸，证明了即使不盈利的智能体也能保持高规则遵循度，整体在扣除费用后净盈利，且机构级风控在29%的市场回撤中有效控制了损失，为交易者在赋予智能体真实资金前提供了一个区分运气与纪律的评估工具包。
en_tdlr: The study analyzed 2,627 closed positions from four AI trading agents, demonstrating high rule adherence even among unprofitable agents, net positive results after fees, and institutional-style risk controls that contained losses through a 29% market drawdown—offering traders an evaluation toolkit to separate luck from discipline before granting agents real capital.
